title: Watch electricity hit a fork in the road at half a billion frames per second
summary: AlphaPhoenix uses a custom high-speed measurement setup to watch voltage waves travel down wires and split at a fork. It answers how electricity knows where to go and how quickly that process happens.
why: Praised as the clearest visual explanation of transmission lines, impedance and signal propagation, with several commenters saying it made it all click.

quote.text: by far the best explanations of electricity that I've encountered in any format
